name: Microgrid storage contactor-state confirmation
summary: Associates the declared battery connection state with the assigned storage control interface.
description: Associates the declared battery connection state with the assigned storage control interface. Storage coordination combines the battery's energy limits with the converter's electrical capability and the microgrid's operating demand. State of charge, allowable power and connection status describe different aspects of availability.

In a microgrid with a battery energy storage system, the controller can request discharge to support a power deficit while the battery management and conversion systems enforce their own operating limits. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Battery contactor status” at the input and “Storage connection confirmation” at the output. Status follows the selected battery system architecture.
